semantics.identity_rule: Each tool invocation request has an explicit identity.
semantics.tool_rule: Exact tool identity/version/provider binding is referenced.
semantics.argument_rule: Arguments validate against exact tool schema.
semantics.inert_rule: Request has no side effect before runtime validation/authorization/dispatch.
semantics.model_rule: Model-generated tool call is candidate request, not authority.
semantics.authority_rule: Caller/model does not inherit tool-provider permissions.

invariants.rule: Command, Routine, Trigger, Schedule, Tool and model definitions remain separate from invocations, requests, executions and results; definitions never create effects merely by existing.
Automated work still resolves exact operation/target/context and must cross validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before any effect occurs.
